related.title: Triton fused softmax：中間張量消除
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：邏輯答案不變，同址廣播另處理，週期結果標為簡化bank模型。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Logical results match, broadcast is treated separately, and cycles are labeled as a simplified model.
related.difference: 列出每個中間張量的讀寫，驗證融合後數值穩定性與流量降低。
related.differenceEn: List reads/writes for intermediates, and verify stable numerical results after fusion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 32個4-byte bank模型中，bank=(word address mod32)；32列陣列逐欄存取的步距32使地址落同bank。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 32執行緒，row-major32×32教學陣列，每執行緒讀同一欄不同列，假設每bank每週期服務一個不同字。 32個不同字落同bank，需32服務週期；不是同址廣播。
未融合的max讀N、減值讀寫2N、exp讀寫2N、sum讀N、除法讀寫2N，共8Ns主張量bytes；融合只需2Ns，前提中間量留片上。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=2^20元素、s=4 bytes，只計完整主張量往返，較小的列統計陣列另外列出。 未融合主張量流量8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB；是逐算子物化模型，不代表所有softmax實作。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For32 banks of 4-byte words, bank=word address mod32; column access at stride32 maps to one bank. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 32 threads read one column across32 rows of a row-major32×32 array; one distinct word/bank/cycle. 32 distinct words land in one bank, requiring32 service cycles; this is not same-address broadcast.

Unfused max reads N, subtraction reads/writes2N, exp2N, sum reads N, and division2N:8Ns main-tensor bytes; fusion uses2Ns when intermediates stay on chip. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N=2^20 elements, s=4 bytes, counting full main-tensor traffic and listing smaller row-statistic arrays separately. Unfused main-tensor traffic=8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB for materialized operators, not every softmax implementation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Apache TVM MetaSchedule：調參成本與回本
related.titleEn: Apache TVM MetaSchedule: tuning cost and amortization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：邏輯答案不變，同址廣播另處理，週期結果標為簡化bank模型。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Logical results match, broadcast is treated separately, and cycles are labeled as a simplified model.
related.difference: 把一次性編譯成本與每次執行節省分開，保留目標裝置及形狀的有效範圍。
related.differenceEn: Separate one-time tuning from per-run savings and retain target/shape validity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 32個4-byte bank模型中，bank=(word address mod32)；32列陣列逐欄存取的步距32使地址落同bank。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 32執行緒，row-major32×32教學陣列，每執行緒讀同一欄不同列，假設每bank每週期服務一個不同字。 32個不同字落同bank，需32服務週期；不是同址廣播。
回本次數N=Ctune/(told−tnew)，只有每次節省為正才有有限回本點。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 調參耗時600 s，原每次20 ms，新每次16 ms，工作形狀固定。 N=600/(0.020−0.016)=150000次；此後才抵銷調參時間。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For32 banks of 4-byte words, bank=word address mod32; column access at stride32 maps to one bank. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 32 threads read one column across32 rows of a row-major32×32 array; one distinct word/bank/cycle. 32 distinct words land in one bank, requiring32 service cycles; this is not same-address broadcast.

Break-even runs N=Ctune/(told−tnew), finite only for positive per-run savings. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Tuning600 s, old20 ms/run, new16 ms/run, fixed shapes. N=150000 runs before tuning time is amortized.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
